label: Calculate the likelihood of an all-on supplier panel on distinct rays
meaning: The numbering is a bijection from the ray identities actually observed on intact tails. Duplicated positions read the same sampled coordinate. The intersection covers every coordinate in that numbering. A blocked observation makes the all-positive event empty, including when there are no live rays. The sample is a shared coordinate and an independent product of local coordinates. This gives a likelihood for a fixed observation under an explicit law, while causal ancestry and how the actual settings arose remain separate questions.
